subject: angol
title: People, friendship and society
instructionsHu: A vizsgáztató a barátságról, a generációk közötti különbségekről, a társadalmi szerepekről és az ünnepekről kérdez. Válaszolj részletesen, indokold a véleményedet, és mondj példákat.

questions.q: How would your friends describe you?
Which qualities do you value most in a friend? Why?
followUps: Have you ever lost a friend? What happened?

questions.q: Do you think it's possible to have real friends online? Why or why not?
Who is a role model for you, and why?
In what ways are teenagers today different from their parents' generation?
Do you think men and women have equal opportunities in Hungary today?
How important is it for you to follow fashion? Why?
Which holiday do you think has lost its original meaning? Why?
Have you ever done voluntary work? What did you learn from it?
Which social problem in your country worries you most, and why?

usefulPhrases.en: Loyalty matters more to me than ...
usefulPhrases.hu: A hűség többet számít nekem, mint ...

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: How would your friends describe you?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I think they'd say I'm reliable and quite funny, but maybe a bit stubborn. I'm usually the one who organises things like birthday parties, because I hate it when plans fall apart at the last minute.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Which qualities do you value most in a friend? Why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Honesty and loyalty. I'd rather have a friend who tells me the truth, even if it hurts, than someone who just says what I want to hear.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Have you ever lost a friend? What happened?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, unfortunately. My best friend from primary school moved to Győr, and although we promised to stay in touch, we gradually drifted apart. There wasn't any argument – we just didn't have much in common any more.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you think it's possible to have real friends online? Why or why not?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I think so, to some extent. I've got a Polish friend I met in an online gaming community, and we chat almost every day. Still, I believe a friendship only becomes really strong once you've spent time together in person.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Which social problem in your country worries you most, and why?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Probably the number of young, educated people who leave Hungary to work abroad. If this continues, there won't be enough doctors and nurses, and many small towns will slowly empty.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó a személyes kérdésekre őszinte, példával alátámasztott választ ad (elköltözött barát, lengyel online barát), a társadalmi kérdésnél pedig a problémát és a következményeit is megnevezi.
Nyelvhelyesség: változatos B2-es szerkezetek hiba nélkül – 'I'd rather … than …', 'although' és 'once' kezdetű mellékmondatok, első feltételes mondat (If this continues, there won't be …).
Szókincs: a kapcsolatok idiomatikus kifejezései (stay in touch, drift apart, have much in common) és pontos társadalmi szavak (educated, work abroad).
Érdemes megtanulni: „plans fall apart at the last minute”, „I'd rather have a friend who …”, „we gradually drifted apart”, „in person”.
